ev.q: is an American comedy animated television series
centers on Bessie Higgenbottom, an ambitious Honeybee girl scout
Many recurring characters appear alongside the Higgenbottom family
Bessie and Ben live with their single mother, Hilary
Penny is Bessie's clumsy, dim-witted, obese best friend
the show makes light of her disregard for her adoring younger brother's feelings
renewed for a second and final season
